alex li: Quick heads-up — I pushed a small rename in PR #3129 (Config -> ServerConfig). CI is failing with a couple of lint errors and one json-tag mismatch in pkg/server/handler.go. Want to merge today if we can get this green.

maria gonzalez: :eyes: I can take a look. Are the failures just formatting or do we have API/json tag changes to fix?

alex li: Mostly naming + one exported comment that needs rewording. I ran `gofumpt` locally and it fixed two files, but CI still flags the tags and one test.
ravi: I can do a quick pass in ~30min. If it's just tags/comments/tests, should be trivial.
sam: Heads up — TestServerConfigDefaults in pkg/server/test_test.go references the old field. I can push a tiny test update to your branch unless you prefer to handle it.
alex li: Please push to my branch, thanks. Also leaving the minimal diff I did here: ```diff
- type Config struct { Addr string `json:"addr"` }
+ type ServerConfig struct { Addr string `json:"addr"` }
```

ci-bot: ci/cirrus — re-run requested by sam. Status: queued.

maria gonzalez: I fixed the json tag in pkg/server/handler.go and adjusted the exported comment to mention ServerConfig. Running `make format && go test ./...` now.
ravi: Quick nit: internal helper `exportPrivate` should probably be `exportPriv` for consistency with other helpers. Not blocking, but left a comment.
sam: :thumbsup: Pushing test rename and a tiny import tidy in 5.
alex li: pushed the test rename and addressed ravi's nit (renamed helper). Can someone approve so I can merge during the 16:00 PST merge window?
maria gonzalez: Approving now. :white_check_mark:
ravi: approved. :thumbsup:
ci-bot: ci/cirrus — build passed. All checks green.
alex li: Merging now. Thanks everyone for the quick turn-around!
